added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite gate log (a docs-only node ran no suite), so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: blocking: scopeB.log_final_census names scratch/census-scopeB-final.json as the scope's final census, but that file reads discovered 43 / described 1555 / embedded 1555 (reproduced: cat scratch/census-scopeB-final.json), taken before the second pass scopeB-enrich2, directly contradicting the final_census block at :35 (discovered 0 / described 1598); the genuinely final numbers exist only in scratch/final-census.json, which this record does not cite, so a later reader opening the named receipt sees the record's own claim falsified and the done_when clause "each scope's ... final census ... captured to logs" is not met by the artifact named.

follow-on: scopeA.log_final_census names scratch/census-scopeA-final.json, which reads with_role 346 while the final_census block at :23 claims with_role 1029; the named log predates the role backfill recorded at :42-46, so it is not the scope's final census.

follow-on: the narrative and reprocess-progress-bulk-8.json:15 report a measured rate of "roughly 200 signals per minute", but the enrichment records show scope A at 1029 signals / 590 s = about 105/min and scope B at 1598 / 1164 s = about 82/min, so the rate used to size the scopes is not the rate the run's own records show.

follow-on: the fragment's headline reports 2627 signals in these four categories while the node's done_when assigns them at 1902 signals, and the record never reconciles the difference; the peer progress files show the four categories' totals are genuinely 2627 and the 1902 describes the remaining work this node took over (bulk-4 left 898 of a048717 unreset; bulk-5 left CryoCTB and b240064 unstretched), so the artifact overstates this node's share of new work by re-resetting whole categories without saying so.
